section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Planetary Gear Output Shaft)
title: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Planetary Gear Output Shaft)

content.description: Illustration showing a planetary gear assembly with labels indicating 'Lock' and 'Free' positions for one-way clutch testing

items.heading: TEMPORARILY INSTALL REACTION PLATE ON PLANETARY
items.text: Insert the plate into place for testing of the one-way clutch.

items.heading: TEST ONE-WAY CLUTCH
items.text:
The planetary gear must rotate freely counterclockwise and lock clockwise.
If the clutch does not work correctly, it must be replaced.

content.description: Illustration showing planetary carrier and installation of nylon thrust washer

items.heading: INSTALL NYLON THRUST WASHER ON FRONT PLANETARY CARRIER
items.text: Apply petroleum jelly to the washer to hold it in place during later assembly. Match the lugs with the planetary carrier.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of front planetary gear assembly to intermediate shaft

items.heading: INSTALL FRONT PLANETARY GEAR ASSEMBLY TO INTERMEDIATE SHAFT
INSTALL PRESSURE PLATE
items.text: Install the pressure plate, placing the flat surface toward the intermediate shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of No. 3 brake clutch pack with multiple disc plates on intermediate shaft

items.heading: INSTALL NO. 3 BRAKE CLUTCH PACK
items.text: Using low-pressure compressed air, blow all excess ATF from discs.

content.text: High-pressure air will damage the discs.

items.heading: KEEP INNER RACE, APPLY TUBE, THRUST BEARING AND RACE TOGETHER
